name: DSFR Menus
description: Creation and management of menus (also works with DSFR child themes).
project_description: DSFR Menus is part of the DSFR suite that brings the French State Design System (Systeme de Design de l'Etat) to Drupal. It provides a single admin form that generates a set of standard, DSFR-styled menus (a social-links menu, up to six footer-top column menus, an institutional menu, and a mandatory legal/last footer menu) as real Drupal menu and menu_link_content entities, pre-filled with placeholder or officially-supplied links. Optionally it also creates the matching system_menu_block block instances and places each menu into its expected DSFR theme region, so a French government site obtains compliant footer navigation without hand-building menus and blocks. It builds on dsfr_core and works with DSFR child themes.
